raw.season: We will be running camps from June 29 to Aug. 28th, 2026.
raw.hours: Camps will run from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm with extended hours available.
raw.address: Camps will be held at Sheridan College Hazel McCallion Campus located at 4180 Duke of York Blvd. in Mississauga across from the Square One mall.
raw.businessAddress: 3323 Bethune Rd, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. L5L 4R2
raw.nutFree: Kids should bring a lunch everyday except on Fridays, snacks (we have 1 morning and 1 afternoon snack break), a labelled water bottle, a hat and sunscreen. Our facility is nut free so please make sure lunches and snacks are nut free. They should arrive with sunscreen already applied. We will have the kids reapply sunscreen after lunch. Kids in the sports camp should wear running shoes.
raw.extendedHours: Extended hours are available from 7:30 am to 9:00 am and from 4:00 pm to 6:00 pm. The cost is $35.00 plus HST per child for the morning portion and $35.00 plus HST for the afternoon portion.
raw.cancellation: Cancellations must be made 2 weeks prior to the first day of camp by email. An admin fee of $25 will apply for each week and each child cancelled. Changes in the camp dates can be made at any time with no fee providing there is space in the new week.
raw.staffRatio: class of 10 kids with 1 teacher | class of 12 kids of 4 and 5 year old's with 2 teachers
